typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	AutoAsOfDateInd as string (),
	LogicalSourceCode as string (),
	StagingDB as string ()
}

source(output(
		BatchID as integer,
		LoadId as integer,
		StartTime as timestamp,
		LoadDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'with ctea as( select MaxBatchId =  isnull(Max(batchid),0) from control.Batch )    Select BatchID = isnull(batchid,0) +1 ,LoadId = isnull(case when a.LoadId is not null Then  case when [LoadCompletionFlag] = \'Y\' then LoadId +1 else LoadId  end   end,1)                  ,[LoadDate]=SYSDATETIME ( )   	  ,[StartTime]=SYSDATETIME ( )          from control.Batch a right join ctea b on isnull(batchid,0)  = b.MaxBatchId',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(StagingDB = toString($StagingDB),
		LogicalSourceSystemCode = toString($LogicalSourceCode),
		ProcessType = iif($AutoAsOfDateInd == 'D', 'Regular Process', 'Merge Process')) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		LoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		LogicalSourceSystemCode as string,
		BatchId as integer,
		LoadProcessType as string,
		StartTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		LoadId as integer,
		StagingDatabase as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		LogicalSourceSystemCode,
		BatchId = BatchID,
		LoadProcessType = ProcessType,
		StartTime,
		LoadId,
		StagingDatabase = StagingDB)) ~> DSTBatchId
